class.name: FmodBankLoader
class.brief_description: A node that automatically loads FMOD Studio banks when it enters the scene tree.
class.description:
FmodBankLoader loads one or more FMOD Studio bank files when its parent scene is entered. This is a convenient way to ensure the right banks are loaded for a given level or screen without manual loading code.
Assign bank file paths to [member bank_paths] in the Inspector. All banks are loaded with [code]FMOD_STUDIO_LOAD_BANK_NORMAL[/code] (synchronous loading) when the node calls [code]_enter_tree[/code].
[b]Note:[/b] FmodBankLoader does nothing when running in the editor to avoid accidentally loading banks during design time.

method.name: get_bank_paths
method.description: Returns the array of bank file paths configured on this node.

method.name: set_bank_paths
method.description: Sets the array of bank file paths to load. Each element should be a [String] path to a [code].bank[/code] file (e.g. [code]"res://audio/Music.bank"[/code]).

members.member: An array of paths to FMOD Studio [code].bank[/code] files. All listed banks are loaded when this node enters the scene tree.
